input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

execution_mode_options.title: Execution mode options
execution_mode_options.description: Options that define the starting point and scope of the pipeline execution. These options allow partial execution or resumption from intermediate steps.

only_preprocessing.description: Run only the preprocessing steps — including trimming, validation, and FastQC/MultiQC. Skips quantification, differential expression analysis (DEA), and miRNA annotation.

from_counts.description: Indicates that the input samplesheet provides paths to raw count tables instead of sequencing libraries. The pipeline starts from the quantification step using these tables.

from_dea.description: Indicates that the input samplesheet provides paths to DEA result tables. The pipeline skips quantification and DEA, starting directly from miRNA annotation.

fastqc_multiqc_optios.title: FastQC/MultiQC optios
fastqc_multiqc_optios.description: Options to customize FastQC and MultiQC behavior.

extra_fastqc_args.description: Extra options to customize FastQC execution.

extra_multiqc_args.description: Extra options to customize MultiQC report generation.

trimming_options.title: Trimming options
trimming_options.description: Options to adjust read trimming criteria.

trimming_adapters.description: FASTA file with the adapters that must be removed during the trimming process.

trimming_custom_args.description: User-defined extra parameters to customize fastp behavior during read trimming.

validation_options.title: Validation options
validation_options.description: Options to define criteria for validating sequencing libraries and experimental comparisons.

validation_depth.description: Minimum read depth required for a sequencing library to be considered valid.

validation_rep.description: Minimum number of biological replicates needed to validate a comparison (e.g., control vs treated)

filtering_options.title: Filtering options
filtering_options.description: Options to configure filtering of sequencing reads based on database or genome alignment criteria.

filt_db.description: Path to the FASTA file used to remove sequences from the libraries. Database-based filtering is only performed if this file is provided.

filt_genome.description: Indicates whether the libraries are aligned to the species genome.

bowtie_filt_db_ext_args.description: Additional parameters to pass to Bowtie for database filtering

bowtie_filt_genome_ext_args.description: Additional parameters to pass to Bowtie for genome filtering.

quantification_options.title: Quantification options
quantification_options.description: Parameters related to the quantification of sequencing reads and filtering based on count thresholds.

min_counts.description: Minimum number of counts required for a sequence to be considered.

min_samples.description: Minimum number of samples in which the sequence must meet the min_counts threshold to avoid being filtered out.

counts_not_memory.description: Indicates whether the SQLite database used to generate the count matrices should not be loaded into memory. This will result in higher memory usage but better performance

dea_options.title: DEA options
dea_options.description: Options related to exploratory analysis (EA) and subsequent differential expression analysis (DEA).

ea_p_value.description: P-value threshold for Mann-Whitney and Wilcoxon tests used to assess whether sample groups are spatially separated in Principal Component Analysis (PCA).

dea_alpha.description: Significance level (alpha) used for determining statistical significance in DEA.

annotation_options.title: Annotation options
annotation_options.description: Options for miRNA annotation of differentially expressed sequences through curated databases and specific criteria.

databases.description: Comma-separated string indicating the databases to use for miRNA identification and their order of preference. The search proceeds sequentially through the listed databases until the species is found. Allowed databases are: miRBase, sRNAanno, and/or PmiREN.

mirna_classes.description: Comma-separated string specifying which miRNA classes or variants will be considered during the annotation process.
mirna_classes.help_text:
These are the miRNA classes that can be included in the string:

    ref_miRNA: Canonical miRNA sequence, perfectly matching the reference.

    iso_5p: Shift in the 5′ end of the sequence (e.g., iso_5p:+1 or iso_5p:−1).

    iso_3p: Shift in the 3′ end of the sequence.

    iso_add5p: Non-templated nucleotide additions at the 5′ end.

    iso_add3p: Non-templated nucleotide additions at the 3′ end.

    iso_snv_seed: Single nucleotide variants (SNVs) in the seed region (positions 2–7).

    iso_snv_central_offset: SNVs at position 8.

    iso_snv_central: SNVs in positions 9–12.

    iso_snv_central_supp: SNVs in the supplementary region (positions 13–17).

    iso_snv: SNVs outside of the regions defined above.

    Mixed: Sequences that exhibit a combination of variant types.

    Mixed_shift: Mixed variants that result in a shift of the seed region.

    Undefined: Sequences that match multiple variant categories without a clear dominant class.

substitutions.description: Maximum number of allowed internal substitutions (not at sequence ends).

five_add.description: Maximum number of non-templated nucleotides allowed at the 5' end.

three_add.description: Maximum number of non-templated nucleotides allowed at the 3' end.

ends_modification.description: Maximum total allowed modifications (substitutions) across both ends (5' + 3').

bowtie_nti_ext_args.description: Additional parameters to pass to Bowtie to remove sequences identified as non-templated isomiRs that are found in other regions of the genome.

annotation_unitas.description: Indicates whether to perform annotation using the Unitas program instead of the default annotation methodology.

counts.description: Minimum raw counts required for a sequence to be retained for the annotation step.
counts.help_text: Minimum number of raw counts required for a sequence to be retained in the analysis. Sequences with fewer counts will be filtered out. This argument is mutually exclusive with '--rpm'.

rpm.description: Minimum Reads per million (RPM) required for a sequence to be retained for the annotation step.
rpm.help_text: Minimum number of RPM required for a sequence to be retained in the analysis. Sequences with fewer counts will be filtered out. This argument is mutually exclusive with '--counts'.

ignore_threshold_for_canonical.description: Indicates whether canonical miRNA sequences should bypass the abundance threshold filter (e.g., RPM or read count). If set, canonical sequences will pass the filter regardless of their abundance.

reuse_dbs.help_text: If enabled, the pipeline will reuse previously downloaded and published database files from a prior execution, avoiding repeated downloads. This option assumes that the required database files already exist in the outdir directory structure. Use this to speed up re-runs or when re-analyzing data without changes to the reference databases.
reuse_dbs.description: If enabled, the pipeline will reuse previously downloaded and published database files from a prior execution, avoiding repeated downloads.

mirbase.description: Path to the directory containing mature and hairpin FASTA files from miRBase.

srnaanno.description: Path to the directory containing mature and hairpin FASTA files from sRNAanno.

pmiren.description: Path to the directory containing mature and hairpin FASTA files from PmiREN.

species_ids.description: Path to the CSV file with species identifiers from miRBase, sRNAanno and PmiREN.

process_skipping_options.title: Process skipping options
process_skipping_options.description: Options to skip various steps within the workflow.

skip_trimming.description: Skip trimming. ⚠ Use this option only if the input libraries have already been trimmed and contain only clean reads composed exclusively of A, C, G, and T bases.

skip_qc_trim.description: Skip FastQC and MultiQC on trimmed reads.

skip_annotation.description: Skip miRNA annotation of differentially expressed sequences.

global_analysis.title: Global analysis
global_analysis.description: Options related to the global analysis of the results obtained at the different steps of the pipeline.

global_matrix.description: Boolean specifying whether to generate presence/absence and log2FC matrices of miRNAs based on the results of the contrasted comparisons in the differential expression analyses.
global_matrix.help_text:
f enabled, two matrices are produced: one indicating the presence or absence of differentially expressed miRNA families, and another containing their corresponding log2 fold change values.
Each row in the matrices represents a miRNA family, while each column corresponds to a specific comparison (contrast) performed during differential expression analysis.
Comparisons are labeled using unique numeric identifiers that encapsulate information such as species, treatment, and any additional user-defined metadata fields, allowing for more flexible downstream analyses and visualization

global_fields.description: Comma-separated list of metadata fields used to generate comparison identifiers.
global_fields.help_text: This parameter specifies which columns from the input metadata file should be used to define the unique identifiers for each differential expression comparison. These identifiers are used as column names in global summary matrices and help organize results across multiple experimental conditions.

custom_config.description: Path to an additional Nextflow configuration file to override or extend the default pipeline settings.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime.

publish_dir_mode.description: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

modules_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.
